# `company.mileage_reimbursements`

Which check paid somebody back for which trip; immutable, standing while the check is posted.

Database: `company`.

| Column | SQL type | Nullable | Default | Key | Indexes | References | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | primary key 1 | — | — | Stable ULID of this reimbursement link. |

| `transaction_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | unique with trip_id + transaction_id | ix_mileage_reimbursements_transaction | transactions.id | Check that paid it; the link stands while that check is posted. |

| `created_by` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | — | Principal who wrote it. |
| `created_via` | VARCHAR(16) | no | — | — | — | — | Interface it was written through. |
